title: system_word's proofs reach the system temp directory only through the scratch door
intention: Every proof in cairn/tools/system_word takes its temp directory from cairn.tools.scratch.scratch.scratch_dir, so nothing a system_word proof makes outlives its run.
why: Measured 2026-11-12: bare_temp_reach over the repo named 1 system_word line(s): cairn/tools/system_word/proofs/test_a_probe_stub_is_lf_on_every_box.py:52 (tmp = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="cairn-stub-lf-proof-")), landed under 383ac6351996); so cairn/tools/scratch/proofs/test_scratch.py::test_no_proof_in_this_repo_calls_mkdtemp_bare reds. cc_0's 9859b8d64 (ticket 383ac6351996): the LF hook proof took its temp dir from scratch_dir after the scratch-door proof redded its bare mkdtemp.
traces_to: Law 4 (the scratch door is physics, and these lines step around it) and CP6 (what a proof leaves in /tmp accumulates unseen; 3581 dirs did once).
how: At each site, replace Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=P)) with scratch_dir(P), imported from cairn.tools.scratch.scratch, and drop the tempfile import where nothing else uses it: cairn/tools/system_word/proofs/test_a_probe_stub_is_lf_on_every_box.py:52 (tmp = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="cairn-stub-lf-proof-")), landed under 383ac6351996). Precedent: cc_0's 9859b8d64 (ticket 383ac6351996): the LF hook proof took its temp dir from scratch_dir after the scratch-door proof redded its bare mkdtemp. New red-first proof cairn/tools/system_word/proofs/test_system_words_proofs_reach_temp_only_through_the_scratch_door.py, the pattern of cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_base_proofs_reach_temp_only_through_the_scratch_door.py: one tooth test_no_proof_in_system_word_reaches_temp_bare asserting bare_temp_reach(REPO / 'cairn/tools/system_word') == [], the scan bound at call time. Proofs-only build: the ticket carries a top-level writes_to.

clauses.claim: bare_temp_reach over cairn/tools/system_word names no line, so no system_word proof reaches the system temp directory except through scratch_dir

decisions.text: D1: each named site takes scratch_dir(prefix) in place of Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=...)).
D2: cairn/tools/system_word/proofs/test_system_words_proofs_reach_temp_only_through_the_scratch_door.py is new, one tooth, the tools/base door proof's pattern.

out: every other component's bare sites (each in its own ticket, RULE 1)
cairn/tools/scratch (the door and the scan are unchanged)
